scenarios.title: Block Netravati Bridge
scenarios.description: Block the full mapped Netravati Bridge road feature inside the Bantwal analysis boundary and recalculate routes across the local network.
scenarios.assumptions_statement: The blockage is placed on a mapped main road inside the Bantwal analysis boundary. Routes are recalculated by the live ResQ road graph.
